turns.text: Hello, I moved today and need to update the delivery address for my order.
Please send your order number, the email address you used at checkout, and your full new delivery address, including the postal code.
The order number is SC-4040 and my email is george.miller.v2@example.com. New address is Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara.
The delivery address can only be changed before shipping. Your order has already shipped, so the address hasn’t been changed. A colleague will take over to review what options are available.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified george.miller.v2@example.com requests delivery change after moving today. Policy check denied standard change because already shipped. New address: Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara; postal code not supplied. Please review available options. No change filed.
